items.name: Mistral Large 4 ("Le Chonk")
items.summary: Mistral's biggest model yet: a 1.05-trillion-parameter natively multimodal MoE with 49B active params, 1M-token context and frontier-tier cyber/coding scores. Available via API preview now; open weights land October 27 after red-teaming with governments and cybersecurity partners.

items.name: Reflection AI Beam
items.summary: Nvidia-backed Reflection AI unveiled Beam, its first open-weight model: a 501B-parameter MoE (23B active) for coding and agentic work that claims GLM-5.2-level reasoning at 3-4x less inference compute. Weights due under Apache 2.0 later in October; early access via waitlist.

items.name: Aleph Alpha Kolibri
items.summary: Aleph Alpha released Kolibri, a 78B-parameter open-weight MoE (3B active per token) purpose-built for German: German-optimized tokenizer, 23% German pretraining data, 1M context, and weights under Apache 2.0 on Hugging Face. Pitched as sovereign AI for EU public administration and industry under the EU AI Act.

items.name: OpenAI Decisions API (public beta)
items.summary: OpenAI's DevDay-launched Decisions API entered public beta: a specialized GPT-6 Luna endpoint that returns one of a developer's fixed answers with a confidence score in ~150ms (about 10x faster than the Responses API) at $0.10 per 1M input tokens, no output charges.

items.name: OpenAI frontier math results
items.summary: OpenAI published mathematics results from an unreleased internal frontier model — Lean proof formalizations, reasoning summaries and compute estimates — averaging about three hours of ChatGPT Pro thinking per result. The company says it is working toward releasing the model.
